sloka: तामपि प्रहितां शक्तिं रावणेन बलीयसा ।यत्नतस्ते हरिश्रेष्ठा न शेकुरवमर्दितुम् ।। ६.१०१.४१ ।।
transliteration: tāmapi prahitāṁ śaktiṁ rāvaṇena balīyasā ।yatnataste hariśreṣṭhā na śekuravamarditum ।। 6.101.41 ।।

translations.english: It was not feasible for the best of Vanaras to pull out the javelin (from Lakshmana's body) discharged with great strength from Ravana's hand, despite great efforts.
